capabilities: Suggest notes while typing their name without the [[ opener
Insert wikilinks from the suggestion list
Configure triggers by folders, minimum characters and capitalization
Coexist with or replace other line-wide suggestion menus such as Tasks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A convenience function that removes the need to type [[ before creating a wikilink.
problem: Obsidian only offers note link suggestions after you type [[, so linking to frequently referenced notes takes extra keystrokes and mistyped openers get no suggestions at all.

relations.evidence: on a task line its menu is open almost everywhere. By default Littera Nexa replaces it

summary: Autocomplete helper that suggests and inserts note links as you type a note's name, without typing the [[ opener first.
